simple.meaning: תּוֹעָה (tôwʻâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “mistake , i.e. (morally) impiety , or (political) injury.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Nehemiah 4:2. The surrounding context includes family, sacrifice.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תּוֹעָה (H8442) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תּוֹעָה (tôwʻâh) / H8442 is traced through Nehemiah 4:2, Isaiah 32:6 with generated occurrence evidence.
